meta.description: Automated ingestion of National Weather Service alerts via weather.gov API. Fetches active alerts, normalizes data, deduplicates, and submits to Harvy automation pipeline.
requirements: WEBSHARE_PROXY_URL must be configured for egress
HARVY_API_KEY must be set in n8n credentials
Spider Unlimited route must be approved for weather.gov
Source must be approved in harvy-upstream-manifest.json
Basin send token must be configured for processed data
